info.title: LastDB ExeMem Cloud API
info.description: Design contract for cloud API v3. Node traffic uses Ed25519 `nodeSignature` headers (not bearer / API key). See docs/designs/cloud-api.md Decisions 19–20.

post.description: Body is one envelope or an array of envelopes (max 90). Request ≤ 256 KiB; response ≤ 8 MiB (per-item batch_too_large). One Ed25519 signature covers the whole body. No Cloud-Protocol header. Intents: register, payment, deactivate, add_device, remove_device, databases, status. No login; no API keys; no per-device keys; no node-key rotation; no invite/claim/connect-code surface (People app). add_device: empty args; header device is new; existing account node-key signature suffices. register rate-limited → 429 rate_limited / account.register. payment → signed payment_url. databases: paginated owned/granted DBs. status: paid, storage_used_bytes, devices. App registry publish requires a paid ExeMem account.

register.summary: First device; device id is the signed header

add_device.summary: Existing account node-key signature; header device id is the new device; args empty

payment.summary: Returns a short-lived single-use signed payment URL

databases.summary: Page of DBs this node key owns or is granted

status.summary: Paid state, storage used, registered devices

nodeSignature.name: X-LastDB-Signature
nodeSignature.description:
Ed25519 signature (base64url, no pad) over UTF-8 lines joined by newline: POST
<path>
<protocol|->
<node key hex>
<device id>
<issued-at ms>
<nonce hex>
<body sha256 hex>. Companion headers: X-LastDB-Node-Key, X-LastDB-Device-Id, X-LastDB-Issued-At, X-LastDB-Nonce. Clock skew ±5 minutes. Replaces LastDBNode bearer and X-API-Key. Bad signature → 401 field request.signature; expired → request.issued_at; reused nonce → request.nonce.

githubOidc.description: GitHub Actions OIDC for DEV maintenance only.

CloudProtocol.name: X-LastDB-Cloud-Protocol
CloudProtocol.description: Wire protocol version. Required on fetch/push/manage/maintenance. Not on account.

NodeKey.name: X-LastDB-Node-Key
NodeKey.description: Ed25519 public key (64 hex). Account identity.

DeviceId.name: X-LastDB-Device-Id
DeviceId.description: Registered device UUID for this request.

IssuedAt.name: X-LastDB-Issued-At
IssuedAt.description: Unix milliseconds when the signature was made.

Nonce.name: X-LastDB-Nonce
Nonce.description: 32 random bytes as 64 hex; single-use per node key.

FetchResult.description: Typed by intent; see design doc.

AccountDatabaseRole.description: publisher = owns the DB; writer/reader = active member grant (today's ShareMemberRole Submit/Read).

added_at_ms.description: Unix ms when the device was registered. Omit when ExeMem has not stored it (not on today's register wire).

oneOf.description: payment — result is payment_url (short-lived single-use signed link) + expires_at_ms
add_device — new device is X-LastDB-Device-Id; node-key signature for an existing account is enough (no body proof; unknown-device 401 waived for this intent)

cursor.description: Opaque page token; omit on first page

oneOf.description: databases — ExeMem reverse index of owned + granted DBs (not available as a single call today)

payment_url.description: Short-lived, single-use, signed link to the hosted payment page (browser has no node key).

cursor.description: Next page token; omit when done

paid.description: Active paid plan. Today: payments/status active (or unpaid → payment.subscription / PAID_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED).

storage_used_bytes.description: Cloud bytes charged to this account. Not exposed on today's wire — ExeMem must report it. No account storage limit is exposed today, so no limit field.

devices.description: Registered devices. No list API today; added_at_ms when ExeMem stores it.
